correctness.rationale: Exact rank-three vertex-transitive pair-spectrum criterion is proved including repeated selections. In Cartesian cycle products of dimension at least two, common-neighbor count at most two, private-neighbor existence, and a counting argument (with an explicit 3-by-3 exception) give universal witness patterns 00,01,10; 11 is controlled precisely by triangle-factor edges or distance two. The product diameter formula supplies all remaining cases. Direct cyclic-distance analysis gives the five one-factor types. Eight distinct spectra prove both directions and sharp 27-vertex representative size for all finite dimensions. Two standalone enumerators test finite cases; neither is used to infer infinity.

value.rationale: A complete exact logical classification for arbitrary dimension and arbitrary cycle factor lengths is a natural nontrivial structural target. Its eight classes exhibit cross-dimensional collapse, including rank-three equivalence of a seven-cycle with unbounded-degree multidimensional tori, while separating three distinct triangle-containing regimes. The sharp maximum smallest family representative 27 and explicit formulas/spectra give reusable finite-model-theoretic boundary information. This exceeds a single small example or arbitrary parameter slice; no claim of new EF methodology is made.
